brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build provides shelf surfaces (cover:0,0,1;full;top at level 1 and cover:0,1,0;full;top at level 0) staged with book-stack prop, but parts are 3D-printed plastic and configurator verifies only fit/collision, not material strength, load rating or waterproofing. No 50 kg rating can be claimed or verified.
Two drawers installed: drawer:0#1,0#cut on piece:1,0,0;half-n (east) and drawer:0#-1,0#cut on piece:-1,0,0;half-s (west), both visible and operable.

finish.summary: Built compact shelf arrangement with upper shelf (piece:0,0,1;full) and side shelf (piece:0,1,0;full), plus two half-base drawer units at base. Dressed with books to show use. Load rating cannot be met by the configurator; structure shape provides shelf function but not verified 50 kg capacity.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
